newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures trim gains, still higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures trim gains, still higher.

text.p: July 23 - U.S. stock index futures trimmed gains, stayed higher. Fed's Rivlin said "tough call" whether Fed needs to raise rates more, that upside risk of more inflation outweighs recession risk. Sept S&P 500s had hit new all-time peak at 949.25 on good dealer buying, higher T-bond futures, good earnings. Arb buy programs seen early. Fair value 5.25 pts.
